instructions: Toast 4 slices of the bread and keep them warm.
Melt 3 tbsp of the butter in a large nonstick skillet over low heat. Stir in 1/4 tsp of the salt.
Crack 4 eggs into small bowls, then slide them into the pan, keeping the yolks whole.
Raise the heat to medium and tilt the pan so the whites spread toward the edges. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are firm. If the butter spits, lower the heat.
Take the pan off the heat and sprinkle the eggs with half the pepper. Slide them onto two plates with the toast.
Toast 4 more slices. Repeat with the remaining butter, salt, eggs and pepper.
Serve with the toast, and put the chili flakes on the table for anyone who wants them.
method_notes: Turkeys for Life leads (no ratings, so this is a fallback lead): eggs slid into melted butter, cooked over medium until the whites are firm, finished with salt, pepper and chili flakes. Cup of Yum has the same method and Yemek.com agrees on butter, salt and a pinch of red pepper flakes. Bread is gluten-free to keep the tag; the chili flakes move to the table.
